review: I like how this looks: each stage has its own colour, and the spikes, lasers and springs are easy to read on a small screen. First Steps is a gentle start, and Spring Loaded is the one I would replay, because the bounces feel generous. Saw Mill is where I would put the phone down. It is only stage 3, the small saws float at jump height, and the recorded mid player died right beside the goal. Spike Garden puts a lot of spikes on me very early. Gauntlet mixes everything fairly, but the dotted laser posts are faint against the dark sky.
best: Spring Loaded: bouncy, clear, and I can finish it without a cheap death.
worst: Saw Mill is much too hard for stage 3 and kills players right at the goal.
